questions.question: A boy added all natural numbers from 1 to 10, however he added one number twice due to which the sum becomes 58. What is the number which he added twice?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A boy added all natural numbers from 1 to 10,

Also, he added a certain number twice.

**Calculations:**

Let, the number he added twice = x

Sum of all natural numbers from 1 to 10,

⇒ 10 × (10 + 1)/2

⇒ 55

According to problem,

⇒ 55 + x = 58

⇒ x = 3

∴ The number he added twice = 3

questions.question: Ram is five times as efficient as Rohit. Ram can complete a work in 60 days less than Rohit. If both of them work together then in how many days the work would be completed?
questions.solution:
Let, efficiency of Rohit = x/day and efficiency of Ram = 5x/day

Let, Rohit can complete the work in = y days

∴ Ram can complete the work in = (y - 60) days

According to problem,

⇒ x × y = 5x × (y – 60)

⇒ y = 5y – 300

⇒ 4y = 300

⇒ y = 75

Let, when they work together they can complete the work in = z days

According to problem,

⇒ x × 75 = (x + 5x) × z

⇒ 75 = 6z

⇒ z = 12.5

∴ when they work together they can complete the work in = 12.5 days

questions.question: A and B together can complete a work in 20 days. They started together but after 4 days A left the work. The remaining work was completed by B alone in 24 more days. In how many days can A complete the entire work alone?
questions.solution:
(A + B) can complete a work in = 20 days

∴ (A+B)’s 1 day’s work = 1/20 …… (1)

∴ (A+B)’s 4 day’s work = 4/20 = 1/5

∴ Remaining work = 1 - 1/5 = 4/5

∴ B completes 4/5 work in = 24 days

∴ B can complete the work in = 24 × 5/4 = 30 days

∴ B’s 1 day’s work = 1/30 …… (2)

From (1) and (2) we get,

A’s 1 day’s work,

⇒ 1/20 - 1/30

⇒ (3 - 2)/60

⇒ 1/60

∴ A can complete the work in = 60 days

questions.question: What will be the net discount (in percentage) after two successive discounts of 20% and 10%?
questions.solution:
Let, marked price = 100x

1st discount = 20%

∴ Price after 1st discount = (100x - 100x × 20/100) = 80x

2ⁿd discount = 10%

∴ Price after 2ⁿd discount = (80x - 80x × 10/100) = 72x

∴ Net discount,

⇒ (100x - 72x)/100x × 100%

⇒ 28x/100x × 100%

⇒ 28%

questions.question: A, B and C are partners and invest in a business. A invests 1/5th of total and B invests 1/4th of the total. What is the ratio of profit of A, B and C respectively?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A, B and C are partners and invest in a business.

A invests 1/5th of total and B invests 1/4th of the total.

Concept used:

Selling price = Cost price + Cost price × Profit%

Calculation:

Let, total investment = x

A’ investment = x/5

B’s investment = x/4

C’s investment,

⇒ x – x/5 - x/4

⇒ (20x - 4x - 5x)/20

⇒ 11x/20

The ratio of profit of A, B and C respectively,

⇒ (x/5) ∶ (x/4) ∶ (11x/20)

⇒ (1/5 × 20) ∶ (1/4 × 20) ∶ (11/20 × 20)

⇒ 4 ∶ 5 ∶ 11

**∴ The ratio of profit of A, B and C is 4 ∶ 5 ∶ 11.**

questions.question: What is the average of first 17 odd numbers?
questions.solution:
Sum of first 17 odd numbers = (1 + 3 + 5 …… till 17 terms)

The sequence is in Arithmetic Progression.

First term = 1

Common difference = 2

No. of terms = 17

∴ Sum = frac{{17}}{2}[ {2 times 1 + ( {17 - 1} ) times 2} ]

⇒ 17/2 × 34

⇒ 289

∴ the average of first 17 odd numbers,

⇒ 289/17

⇒ 17

questions.question: A trader sells two articles for Rs 1875 each. If he gains 25% on one and losses 25% on other, then what is the value (in Rs) of the loss?

questions.question: If length of a rectangle is increased by 20% and breadth is increased by 30%, then what will be the percentage increase in the area of rectangle?
questions.solution:
Let, original length = x and breadth = y

∴ Original area = xy

After 20% increase, length = x + x × 20/100 = 1.2x

After 30% increase, breadth = y + y × 30/100 = 1.3y

∴ New area = 1.2x × 1.3y = 1.56xy

∴ Percentage increase,

⇒ (1.56xy – xy)/xy × 100%

⇒ 0.56 × 100%

⇒ 56%

questions.question: If (1/x) + (1/y) + (1/z) = 0 and x + y + z = 7, then what is the value of x³ + y³ + z³ - 3xyz?
questions.solution:
⇒ (1/x) + (1/y) + (1/z) = 0

⇒ (yz + zx + xy)/xyz = 0

⇒ xy + yz + zx = 0 ----(1)

⇒ x + y + z = 7 ----(2)

∴ x³ + y³ + z³ - 3xyz

⇒ (x + y + z)(x² + y² + z² - xy - yz - zx)

⇒ 7 × (x² + y² + z² - 0) [putting the value from (1) and (2)]

⇒ 7 × [(x + y + z)² - 2(xy + yz + zx)]

⇒ 7 × (49 - 0)

⇒ 343
